row_semantics: Each row represents a distinct service interface for controlling or querying the status of direction lights, differentiated by their specific function (left/right control or status query).

column_semantics.D: Control Method (e.g., Hard Line Control, Hard Line Status)

core_entities.description: Service interface for controlling left or right direction lights.

core_entities.name: DirectionLight.DirectionLightStatus
core_entities.description: Service interface for querying the status of left front direction lights.

core_conditions.description: Request parameter for controlling direction lights, specifying ON/OFF state.

core_conditions.name: DirectionLightSta
core_conditions.description: Status parameter for reporting the current state of direction lights.

core_timing_constraints.description: The service interfaces are periodically invoked to control or query the direction lights.

engineering_interpretation: This table defines the service interfaces for controlling and monitoring direction lights in a vehicle, enabling tests to verify that the system correctly interprets commands to turn lights ON/OFF and accurately reports their status.
